text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while chatting in the trainer's 
office.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So while you were zoning out, you put salt 
in your coffee instead of sugar... is that 
what happened? Ahaha, what on earth did 
that even taste like~?!
choice_data_list:
It actually gave it a surprisingly rich 
and delicious flavor...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Really? Salt in coffee... 
Surprisingly, that combo kind of works...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, it's true! There's actually 
something called salted coffee. And other 
weird ways to drink it... This could make 
for some great streaming content—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's not what we were talking 
about, was it! Sorry, I just instinctively 
connected it to streaming.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Maybe so~ I do that from time to time. 
I've gotta be careful! Especially today, 
since I have a tea party with Gran-chan 
and the others!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono-san's homemade cake is super 
delicious too! Maru-chan loves this 
flavor~!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-The other day at the racetrack cafe... I 
had some delicious chiffon cake... and 
used it as reference... Marche-san's 
version comes with carrot sauce...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, you really recreated 
restaurant-level flavor! ...Huh—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(“Recreating the Café's New Dessert”! 
Nice, this is gonna get people so 
hyped...!!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
—...chan. ...Love-chan? Um, how... is it? 
The cake...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"It's delicious! Especially this raspberry 
sauce♡ I'm so glad you remembered what I 
like♡"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The tail shampoo I'm using right now has a 
faint scent of chamomile. It's very gentle 
on the skin, too...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, let me smell, let me smell! Whoa~ it 
smells so nice! Huh?! And your tail is so 
silky smooth!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(“Reviewing Tail Care with a Friend!” 
“Favorite Tail Shampoo Scent Rankings!”)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: âLoves-san? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! No, nothing! I was just curious about 
the chamomile scent! Maybe I'll try some 
too?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(――Today is my personal time, a precious 
moment to enjoy a tea party with everyone. 
Streamer brain, into the trash! Don't even 
think about it!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I have a little 
present for everyone today. It's this 
right here..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Whoa, gorgeous...! It's so photogenic!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"So cute~! Roses, tulips, and...? There's 
another cute one further back—ah!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, some petals scattere... Wait, a bunch 
of them fell right into the tea! I'm so 
sorry~~!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's quite alright. These are all 
made from edible flowers, you see. Since 
it's here, why not drink it all down 
together?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, amazing! Ah, and look at that! It's 
like a miracle—the floating petal is 
blooming again on the surface of the black 
tea...!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—Mmh! And it's so good!! The black tea 
flavor matches the sweet floral scent so 
well... It's like something from a cafe!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The short video is up: "[Miraculous 
Creation] An Insanely Delicious Floral Tea 
Was Born"~!!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
This tea party's been pure content gold 
for a while now! I can't hold back 
anymore! Can I record? Can I stream!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me... I lost my composure for a 
moment...

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, were you holding back from talking 
about the stream? I did kind of think you 
seemed a bit spaced out today, though."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I guess it's an occupational 
hazard. I just instinctively connect 
everything to that...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to apologize! And there's 
not a single mile of holding back needed 
either!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... That's just Love-chan's 
personality, and her everyday life... 
So... I think it's okay to take pictures 
whenever you feel like it...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Earlier... wasn't there that short video 
about floral tea...? Would you... like to 
film that too...?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
――! In that case, can we also try making 
some Insta-worthy tea together while 
enjoying Bouquet-chan's flower bouquet?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. That makes me so happy. I'm really 
glad I made the bouquet. Let's definitely 
do it.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I'll edit this into a short video and 
post it for my fan community! Ehehe, I'm 
so happy~♡♡♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—So, it was completely by chance, but 
everyone ended up helping out with filming 
the video for the stream... and that's how 
it happened!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Just as I expected, all the commu-members 
love it... and Gran-chan and the others 
said they want to be on the stream again, 
too♪
choice_data_list:
Doesn't look like you need to cure that 
occupational habit.

Wanna try doing a tea party stream next 
time?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Just as I expected, all the commu-members 
love it... and Gran-chan and the others 
said they want to be on the stream again, 
too♪
choice_data_list:
Doesn't look like you need to cure that 
occupational habit.

Wanna try doing a tea party stream next 
time?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Right? Everyone has their own 
unique personality, yet they all respect 
one another—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that's why everyday moments make for 
such great content♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Everyone is so warm and welcoming, 
they just embrace everything, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'll hold back when I need 
to... but around people who'll let me get 
away with it, maybe I'll spoil myself a 
little♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That might actually be really great! 
Like... livestreaming our tea party with 
Gran-chan and the others just as it is!?
choice_data_list:
And maybe have a remote tea party with 
everyone from the community too.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Awesome!! You're a total genius, Trainer! 
Strike while the iron's hot, let's 
brainstorm the plan right away!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:

Strike while the iron's hot, let's 
brainstorm the plan right away!
